integrity: Finite replay uses exact integer arithmetic; all-length claims depend on the written argument, including the cited double-shift intersection lemma, rather than finite testing.
scientific_limitations: Specialized to binary words and distance exactly two. Refinement of Gabrić 2021 near-commutation structure; an unindexed equivalent could exist. Published unweighted results are not claimed as new.
scientific_scope: Binary indexed words with a nonidentity conjugate at Hamming distance exactly two; exact weight polynomial and cyclic-necklace coefficients for all n>=2.
title: Fixed-content enumeration of binary words with a distance-two conjugate
